data.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27
data.detailed_description:
EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Editions



EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition



Pre-purchase‡ EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition to get:

  • Up to 7 days Early Access
  • Season 1 Premium Pass
  • FUT™ 93+ OVR ICON Player Item (untradeable) for FC 26 (sold separately)
  • FUT™ Player Dribbling Evo for FC 26 (sold separately)
  • Career Dynamic OVR Pre-season Boost

Ultimate Edition also features:
  • 6,000 FC Points over 3 months††
  • FUT™ Player Evo slot
  • 5 Manager Live Challenge Creation Slots
  • 5-Star Senior Scout in Manager Career

Plus all Standard Edition Career and The Grounds content.

†† You must complete the steps to obtain the initial FC Points distribution by August 1, 2027 to receive all 6,000 FC Points. If you redeem after September 26, 2027, you will not receive any FC Points.


EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Standard Edition

Pre-purchase‡ EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Standard Edition to get:

  • Football Ultimate Team™ 92+ OVR ICON Player Item (untradeable) for EA SPORTS FC™ 26 (sold separately)

The Grounds content:
  • The Grounds Signature Sweatsuit
  • Tier 3 Amp inspired by Mbappe
  • 2 Double AXP for 10 Matches Consumables

Career content:
  • Pre-purchase Challenges
  • 3 ICONs/Heroes
  • 5-Star Coach available for hire in Manager Career
  • 5-Star Youth Scout available for hire in Manager Career


About the Game



This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

data.legal_notice:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

‡ This promotional pre-order offer expires on September 24, 2026 at 23:00 UTC. Valid for new purchases of EA SPORTS FC 27 Ultimate Edition ("Product") only from the Steam store or participating retailers. The following item is referred to as the "FC 26 Content": one (1) untradeable Ultimate Team 93+ OVR Player Item, Player Dribbling Evo; all for use in EA SPORTS FC 26. The following items are collectively referred to as the "FC 27 Content": Up to 7 day early access to the Product, Season 1 Premium Pass, Pre-Order Challenges, Dynamic OVR Pre-Season Boost; all for use in Product. The FC 26 Content and FC 27 Content are collectively referred to as the "Pre-Order Content." The following items are collectively referred to as “Ultimate Edition Content”: 6,000 FC Points, one (1) additional Player Evolution slot, three (3) ICONs/Heroes for Career, one (1) 5-star Coach available for hire in Manager Career, one (1) 5-star Youth Scout available for hire in Manager Career, five (5) additional Manager Live Challenge Creation slots, one (1) 5-star Senior Scout for Manager Career, The Grounds Signature Sweatsuit, Tier 3 Amp Inspired by Mbappé, and two (2) Double AXP for 10 Matches Consumables; all for use in Product. To access Pre-Order Content and Ultimate Edition Content, you must redeem your single-use code (if applicable), log into Ultimate Team, log into The Grounds, and create a Career Mode save while connected to EA servers. To redeem the FC 26 Content, you must sign into Ultimate Team in EA SPORTS FC 26 (sold separately) on the same platform used to pre-order the Product, using the same EA Account or platform account associated with the pre-order. Unless otherwise noted, all Pre-Order Content and Ultimate Edition Content will be available beginning September 18, 2026. Pre-Order Content and Ultimate Edition Content is limited to one EA Account, is non-transferable, and may require gameplay to unlock. Consult your retailer for distribution details. Unless otherwise noted, Pre-Order Content will not be available if you redeem after September 25, 2027. FC Points will be distributed in 3 equal increments. The initial distribution will be granted with your initial login into the Ultimate Team in the Product. The second and third distributions will be granted by the 15th day of the following two months, respectively. You must complete the steps to obtain the initial FC Points distribution by August 1, 2027 to receive all 6,000 FC Points. If you redeem after September 26, 2027, you will not receive any FC Points. Season 1 Premium Pass will not be available after Season 1 ends; see https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-27/news/fc-27-release-dates for more info on Season 1 dates, when available. FC 27 International ICON Player Item will be available from September 18, 2026 and will be upgraded to "Champion" version by November 30, 2026; all other Ultimate Edition content will be available from September 18, 2026 unless otherwise noted. Product will be available to download once 7 day early access period begins on September 17, 2026 23:00 UTC. Offer has no cash value and may not be substituted, exchanged, or sold for cash, goods, or services. May not be combined with other offers or prepaid card redeemable for the applicable content unless expressly authorized by EA. Customer is responsible for applicable sales tax. Void where prohibited, taxed, or restricted by law.

Internet connection; EA Account; Steam Account; acceptance of the EA User Agreement (terms.ea.com); and download & installation of EA's client software EA app (ea.com/ea-app) required to play. EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy applies to your use of EA's services. You consent to any personal data collected through your use of EA's services being transferred to the United States, as further explained in the Privacy & Cookie Policy. You must link your EA and Steam Accounts to play; EA will share your Account ID and individual game and play records with Steam to validate your purchase and/or refund request. Access to software content is limited to one EA & one Steam Account & is non-transferable after purchase. You may need to be 13+ or 16+ to register for an EA Account (age may vary, see o.ea.com/ea/child-access for details) & Ultimate Edition content. Brazil residents: You must be 18+ to access online chat features and to get FUT Packs or the Premium Pass with FC Points. Some content may require gameplay to unlock. Mandatory updates may be downloaded automatically, incur broadband fees & require additional storage or purchase to access. EA may provide certain free incremental content &/or updates. EA may retire online features after 30 days notice posted on ea.com/service-updates.

EA User Agreement: terms.ea.com/de for German residents and terms.ea.com for all other residents
EA Privacy & Cookie Policy: privacy.ea.com/de for German residents and privacy.ea.com for all other residents

Ultimate Edition & FC Points purchase are not available in Belgium and South Korea.

To access Ultimate Edition content, you must redeem your single-use code (if applicable), log into Ultimate Team, log into The Grounds, and create a Career Mode save while connected to EA servers. FC Points will be distributed in 3 equal increments. The initial distribution will be granted with your initial login into the Ultimate Team, the second distribution will be granted by the 15th day of the subsequent month, and the 3rd distribution will be granted by the 15th of the following month. You must complete the steps to obtain the initial FC Points distribution by August 1, 2027 to receive all 6,000 FC Points. If you redeem after September 26, 2027, you will not receive any FC Points. Season 1 Premium Pass will not be available after Season 1 ends; see https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-27/news/fc-27-release-dates for more info on Season 1 dates, when available.

Text and audio commentary for languages other than English and the selected Steam client language requires a separate download.
